name: Candidate Manager
description: Custom applicant-tracking system: Candidate and Company content entities with admin lists, profile pages and a REST API.
project_description:

 Candidate Manager
 
 Candidate Manager is a custom Drupal module that allows site administrators to manage a database of candidates and companies, complete with taxonomy-based classification and REST API access.

 This module provides a complete end-to-end entity system for job marketplaces, HR tools, or staffing platforms, built using modern Drupal 10/11 practices.

 Back to top 

 Features
 
 
 Custom Candidate and Company content entities 
 Taxonomy reference fields for Skills and Categories 
 Clean Bootstrap-based UI for list and detail pages 
 Candidate filtering by skill or category 
 Custom list builders and templates 
 REST API endpoints (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) for candidates 
 Markdown support via Parsedown for candidate descriptions or notes 
 Fully uninstallable and Drupal coding standards compliant 
 
 Back to top 

 Use Cases 
 
 Internal recruitment platforms 
 Job boards 
 Candidate and vendor management systems 
 Resume banks or HR systems
